content: Both parents are active, so this is one case where their difference is informative rather than noise: ligand 2 reaches jnk3~0.10 but pays for it with QED 0.446 at 413 Da, while ligand 1 gets 0.08 at 319 Da with QED 0.672. Mass is clearly the wrong currency - the best Phi in the pool belongs to a 242 Da molecule. So I will upgrade the quality of the NH-azine link rather than add another ring system. Ligand 1 presents a plain pyrimidin-2-ylamino at atoms 15-21. I am replacing it with quinazolin-4-ylamino: the anilinoquinazoline is the archetypal ATP-competitive kinase recognition element, it keeps exactly the same single NH linker, and it is a fused electron-poor azine rather than a bare one. Atom 14 is the aromatic carbon carrying that nitrogen and the 14-15 bond is non-ring, so the swap is clean and costs only ~37 Da.
